g.text: FC-08 Staff and account access safeguards
Administrator selects another account and permitted action
Refuse conversion; only Faculty, Program Head,
and Administrator role transitions are allowed
Role change involves Student as current or destination role?
Require Program Head to transfer all owned content first
Keep account unchanged until transfer completes
Removing Faculty access with content still owned?
Apply change and end existing sessions
Record administrative action and email affected person
Preserve account history and learning records
